answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making influence expensive to fake and cheap to verify. A new identity begins as a low-trust vertex with almost no weight in consensus or rewards. Only after peers attest to original, graded work does that vertex accumulate score. Stake locked in basalt-hard escrow, slashed on proven multi-account farming, raises the cost of spawning clones. Long-lived contribution, like a juniper that thickens year after year, then outranks short-lived sockpuppets in attestation graphs and settlement shares.
